who: Lexis, correcting the HC-T01 lane and my own Ergon pass
originally_believed: HC_T01_CORRECTION_2026-09-03.md: the residual novelty is a RIGOUR CELL because 'Tiso fails all-arms, Petak has no operator-side intervention, Kounios measures in a single unablated condition'. Both that lane and my Ergon pass treated the Watson/Kouvaris lineage plus Tiso and Petak as the frontier.
what_changed: The frontier is elsewhere and is older. MISEVIC, OFRIA & LENSKI 2006 has a CLEAN VARIATION-OPERATOR ON/OFF (divide-sex vs divide-asex), a longitudinal EXHAUSTIVE one-mutant detector in BOTH arms, 100+100 replicates with SEM, and an orthogonal probe satisfying the mechanical-versus-evolved separation - 5 of 6 cells, missing only the acquisition link. KUMAWAT ET AL. 2024 PNAS supplies exactly that missing cell, with a within-run precursor observation and a reciprocal transplant control, missing only a clean on/off. Neither work was in any Prometheus registry.
evidence: delegated EC/ALife lane, verbatim quotes from the PMC full texts of both papers, recorded in the scorecard rows and in L_CANDIDATE_PRIOR_ART CPA-01 and CPA-02.
downstream_revision: The residual cell is now ONE cell wide and it is spanned by the UNION of two published papers. HC-T01's marginal contribution is the intersection: a clean on/off AND a within-run acquisition link in one experiment. HC-T01 attempted exactly that intersection and failed the acquisition half. Why the earlier passes missed this: every Prometheus search population so far was seeded on GRN/developmental-bias lineages or on Toussaint's citation graph. Misevic and Kumawat are AVIDA papers. The population was mis-drawn a SECOND time, by domain rather than by author.

who: Lexis, recording a delegated lane's self-corrections
originally_believed: Three separate intermediate results in this pass looked like substantive findings and were in fact instrument failures.
what_changed: (1) A verification harness whose grep produced no output evaluated every check as ABSENT, which was briefly read as evidence of fabricated quotes; it was a shell bug, and all 40 load-bearing quotes were then verified verbatim, 40 of 40. (2) Two-column pdftotext interleaving split running sentences across non-adjacent lines and produced false negatives. (3) A corpus sweep returned zero triple-hits with the A probe firing on 0 of 12,860 abstracts - a degenerate regex, not a null.
downstream_revision: Each was caught and repaired before it entered a conclusion, and in the third case the corpus null was only accepted after the rebuilt probe was validated against a known positive. Recorded because the programme's standing rule is that a detector which fails is a claim about the detector until resolved, and this pass supplied three instances of exactly that inside a single session.
